meaning: Recorded behavior/contract differences in this audit; not an assertion of the user's universal definition of differential.

items.subject: Three control labels versus four static semantic descriptors
items.basis: Current user statement; frozen LocalPlane header and native cases
items.finding: The array [0,1,2,3] is identical on admitted and rejected outcomes; it is not an executed traversal.
items.action: Local comments, test report, and design clarification distinguish descriptors from evidence.
items.remaining: Original 0->1->0->2 implementation and correspondence remain UNRESOLVED.

items.subject: Repeated zero versus repeated occurrence
items.basis: Current user control sequence; distinct native observation IDs
items.finding: The two visits to role 0 must remain separate occurrences. Equality of carried values is neither asserted nor denied.
items.action: Retain occurrence identity separately from the control role; no fourth named control state is introduced.

items.subject: Route revision versus complete state identity
items.basis: Fresh native reuse and conflict cases
items.finding: Reuse increments occurrence and internal reuse_count while revision stays fixed. Conflict increments residual count with fixed revision.
items.action: Record observed differences in route revision, route count, residual count, occurrence, and outcome separately.
items.remaining: The public differential vector is not a complete internal-state reconstruction.

items.subject: Traversal versus directed wiring
items.finding: Traversing 1->0->2 is not by itself evidence of subsequently constructing the required 1->2 connection.
items.action: Record proposed links with source/destination occurrence references, segment context, direction, obligations and evidence references; no reverse edge is inferred.
items.remaining: The original proper-wiring rule, bindings and source code are UNRESOLVED.

items.subject: Wiring proposal versus permission to advance
items.finding: Correct wiring precedes advancement; a generated edge, stage label, route hit or caller-supplied Boolean cannot supply the missing rule.
items.action: Keep advancement unwarranted until the source-defined wiring predicate and its scoped verification are available.
items.remaining: No controller, guessed coverage threshold or synthetic completeness flag is introduced.

items.subject: Reported rejection versus input-validation exception
items.finding: A blank satisfied-obligation ID throws after allocating occurrence 6, with residual count unchanged; next valid call returns occurrence 7.
items.action: Retain failed attempt in outer diagnostic evidence and explicitly limit native failure-custody claims.
items.remaining: No production exception/transaction semantics changed. This does not assert every validation path has this behavior.

items.subject: Passing examples versus a verified complexity bound
items.basis: Original standalone test stdout and source body
items.finding: The functional test neither measures nor proves the advertised asymptotic complexity.
items.action: Remove average-O(1) from the test success message; preserve the separately scoped design statement.
items.remaining: No complexity statement was disproved by this output edit; no latency or memory benchmark was run.
